message.apotheosis_infnite.lol: Vanishing Curse has destroyed the world; don't think you can load it again.
tooltip.apotheosis_infinite.curse_breake: A mystical scroll that purifies the most stubborn hexes.
Usage: Pick up this item in your inventory and Right-Click it onto a cursed item to remove all curses.
tooltip.apotheosis_infinite.config_check: Please review 'apo_inf-common.toml' in your config folder.
Extreme settings (e.g., Max Levels > 255 or World Destruction) can cause permanent data loss or crashes.
text.apotheosis_infinite.limit_reached: The power of this item has reached the configuration limit.
text.apotheosis_infinite.safe_limit_noti: Note: Levels above 255 are capped at 255 for NBT stability.
